title: Three Weeks and One Short Envelope
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：parcel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 parcel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the postman ① tied the parcel that no sender in the office would have described, and he said the tying was the whole of the week. The ② parcel, meaning the bundle itself and not the envelope, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a parcel, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ parcel in that office had the same short envelope beside it, and the ④ parcel at the far box, meaning the parcel they kept for the children to fetch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A parcel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the postman said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the parcel was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the bundle. The ⑥ parcel, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; parcel, he said, is either something you tie or the only word that means both a bundle and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ parcel had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short envelope. The ⑧ parcel of the whole thing, the postman wrote in June, was one office and three weeks of describing; parcel, he said, is either the parcel at the far box or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ parcel I remember is the bundle described in the list, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ parcel, my mother said in 1970, is the only bundle that improves by being described; every parcel, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like a bundle. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 包裹；邮包（指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 包裹；邮包（指那件包裹本身，与薄薄的信封相对）
C. 固定搭配：tie the parcel 捆这一件包裹
D. n. 包裹；邮包（指留给孩子们取的那一件）
E. n. 包裹之事（抽象总称，指一处邮局的包裹之事）
F. n. 包裹；邮包（指收发清单里写到、被描述的那一件）
G. n. 包裹、心意（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心意（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: tied the parcel that no sender in the office would have described
The parcel, meaning the bundle itself and not the envelope
the parcel at the far box
the parcel was the whole of the matter
the parcel had become a line in a list
The parcel of the whole thing
A parcel, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: tie the parcel 意为“捆这一件包裹”，1961 年那位邮差把邮局里没有一位寄信人肯描述的一件包裹做了一遍。
parcel 意为“包裹；邮包”，指那件包裹本身而不是薄薄的信封，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
parcel 意为“包裹；邮包”，指邮局里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一个薄薄的信封。
parcel 意为“包裹；邮包”，指最远那只信箱的留给孩子们取的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
parcel 意为“包裹、心意”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件心意就是那件事的全部。
parcel 意为“心意”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件包裹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
parcel 意为“包裹；邮包”，指收发清单里写到、被描述的那一件，到 1966 年这一件成了收发清单里的一行。
parcel 意为“包裹之事”，邮差六月写道，整件事的包裹之事是一处邮局和三个星期的描述。
parcel 意为“包裹；邮包”，我记得的是收发清单里描述过的那一件，1968 年送完了，至今仍被说成邮局里最安静的一件。
parcel 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，包裹是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的包裹。
